[[Mountain Heart Chest]] will [[spawn]] after defeating [[Cyndr the Mountain Heart]] or [[Magmus]] in the final level of the [[Heart of the Shiverpeaks]] dungeon. Each player in the [[party]] may open the chest and will receive one item from the drop list in normal mode (2 in hard mode). After the chest has been opened by every player, a countdown timer will begin and the party will be [[teleport]]ed outside the dungeon after three minutes.
